experiment: Frozen V5 full-native-frame PNG baseline diagnostic
purpose: Compare full-frame density/timeline against prior 10Hz PNG runs on already consumed sources
policy: Actual V5 stage2_motion_collision four calls and original scores, no candidate module or score modification
input: All existing zero-based native decoded PNGs in each fixed review case; same PNG representation as earlier pilot, no new JPEG conversion or media duplication
preprocessing_limit: Isolates frame density/timeline with PNG representation held fixed. Not a claim of byte-identical official preprocessing; hidden JPEG encoding conditions are unverified.
model: Actual extracted V5 saved NF4 CandidateVLM, one lifecycle
network: Offline model configuration and socket connection blocking
ground_truth_during_inference: No review/label files read. Existing case labels must be null. Human evaluation is a separate later tool.
preservation: Freeze and run are separate; no output overwrite, no retry, all source/case/mapping/PNG and package hashes verified before and after run
prior_10hz_refs: Only hashes of exact prior freeze/report files bound; not parsed or used by inference
scope: Six previously reviewed/evaluated clips, not unseen holdout or a model improvement submission
